heading: Understand the risks.
intro: This disclosure describes material risks of financial markets, digital assets and automated technology. Read before using the services.
notice: You may lose some or all of your capital. No financial result is guaranteed.
footer: Read this disclosure alongside the Terms of Use, Privacy Policy and Program Rules.

sections.title: Financial market risks
sections.content: Prices can be highly volatile and you may lose some or all invested capital. Past performance, simulations and projections do not predict future results.

sections.title: Digital assets and blockchain
sections.content: Blockchain transactions may be irreversible. Wrong addresses or networks, lost keys and security incidents can cause permanent losses. External networks may fail or become congested.

sections.title: Artificial intelligence and automation
sections.content: AI and automated systems may use inaccurate or delayed data, misjudge market conditions or produce unintended actions. Automation cannot eliminate risk or guarantee profit.

sections.title: No guarantee of results
sections.content: Elleva does not promise profits, capital protection, specific returns or uninterrupted performance. Targets and examples are not guarantees.

sections.title: Third-party infrastructure
sections.content: Exchanges, wallet providers, data vendors and blockchain networks can be disrupted or discontinued. Elleva does not control their continued availability.

sections.title: Cybersecurity and operations
sections.content: Systems may be affected by cyberattacks, bugs, outages and human error. Protect your credentials and recovery phrases; no system is entirely secure.

sections.title: Regulation and taxes
sections.content: Rules differ by jurisdiction and may change. You must evaluate local legality and comply with tax and reporting obligations; consult qualified advisers.

sections.title: User responsibility
sections.content: Assess your circumstances and understand the risks before making decisions. Never commit money you cannot afford to lose or rely solely on promotional or automated information.

sections.title: No professional advice
sections.content: Information is for technology-enabled research and decision support. It is not a substitute for independent financial, legal or tax advice.

sections.title: Updates to this disclosure
sections.content: This disclosure may change as services, technology and applicable rules evolve. Check the official Elleva website for the latest version.
